rows.why: He said 'throat hurts' with no owner; Amal prompted 'حل...' and he rebuilt it as حلقي بوجع (chat 7al2i).
The throat (huwwe) is the subject, so the verb is beywajje3 (it hurts), not the I-form; her chat types beywajje3 but she voiced nothing.

rows.medi_said: أنا بعدت، uh, امبارح مع بنات أخوي.
rows.chat: ana a3adet mbaare7 shwai ma3 banaat a5uy

rows.english: Yesterday I spent time with my brother's daughters.

rows.medi_said: عشان الـ، ولاد دايمًا في مدرسة،
rows.why: After في the known place keeps el- (fi el-madrase); Amal only added دايمًا فيه, no voiced fix of el-.
rows.english: Because kids are always at school.

rows.chat: awal ishi ana bafakker fiyyo el-subu7

rows.chat: awal ishi ana bafakker fiyyo el-subu7

rows.why: Amal recast without el- (ما بأكل فطور) right after his الفطور.

rows.why: He picked بقول (say) for 'speak'; Amal said لا لا لا, just بحكي.

rows.amal_said: All of the words are right, بس the order is wrong.
rows.why: Preposition goes before the question word; Amal said the order is wrong and he said عن شو بتحكي.
Asked 'what are you thinking about' he said bitihki (talk); Amal pointed to بتفكري - may be the engine.

rows.medi_said: So is it شو عن فيه؟
rows.amal_said: No, we don't need عن. خلص. It's بفكر فيه. ... فيه شو بتفكري؟
rows.why: fakkar takes fi, not 3an; Amal said No, we don't need عن, في شو بتفكري.
'Do you know' needs the you-form; he said ba3ref (I know) and Amal recast بتعرف; he then said بتعرفي.
rows.english: Do you know how to play this game?

rows.why: Second verb after بتعرفي drops b-; Amal said 'No be' twice and gave تلعب, he said تلعبي.
rows.english: Do you know how to play this game?

rows.amal_said: It's both, but it's listen to me. It's command. / اسمعيني.
rows.why: 'Listen to me' is a command; he gave a present 'I hear you' and Amal said 'It's command' then اسمعيني.
He meant 'I heard'; Amal repeated 'I heard' in English and he switched to past سمعت (PG-22 English signal).
بخوف is 'I am afraid'; a scary sound is بيخوّف (it frightens) as her chat types; she voiced only Great.
rows.english: I heard a scary sound outside.

rows.medi_said: Would it be استنيتي? / استنى، استني، استنيت؟
rows.amal_said: ستني. ... So ate is always past. بس this was like command. ستني is for a girl.
rows.why: Command to a girl is استني; he gave the past 'you waited' and Amal explained -it is past, ستني is the command.

rows.medi_said: Is it شوف- شوفيلي؟ / شوفني. شوفني.

rows.why: 'Look at me' is it6alla3; he used شاف (see) and Amal said No, that's see me.

rows.amal_said: No. At me. / At. تطلع علي.
rows.why: it6alla3 takes 3ala; he put the object on the verb then -li, Amal said 'No. At me' and gave تطلع علي.

rows.amal_said: No. What do I do in questions? / In questions, what's the order of words؟
rows.why: The preposition goes before the question word; Amal said No and asked about question order; he said على شو بتطلعي.

rows.amal_said: No. Don't look. We're using تتطلع.

'at you' (to Amal) is عليكي; he said 'at me' and Amal recast هم بتطلعوا عليكي.

rows.why: 'Explain it to me' is a command; he used present بشرحك and Amal said 'It's command'; he said اشرح.
